description: B2B CSV Import system (upload -> preview -> column map -> validate -> duplicate detection -> assignment -> import) plus Import History. Reuses the proven CSV parsing + synonym auto-map + preview flow from src/routes/_authenticated/leads/import.tsx, adapted to the CA-firm/B2B-lead data model and writing a b2b_import_batches record that stamps every imported row's import_batch_id.
steps: Create route src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/import.tsx. Copy the robust parseCSV + normalizeHeader + synonym-based auto-map + preview approach from leads/import.tsx (do NOT reinvent; csv.ts has only export helpers). Map B2B fields: Firm Name, Contact Person, Designation, Phone, Alternate Phone, Email, Website, City, State, Full Address, Firm Type, Firm Size, Lead Source, Source URL (spec section 7 step 3). Required: Firm Name + at least one of Phone/Email.
Step 4 Validate: flag rows missing required fields or with malformed phone/email as Invalid, with per-row reasons (follow the skippedReasons pattern).

Step 5 Duplicate detection: detect possible duplicates against existing ca_firms/b2b_leads AND within the uploaded file using combinations: exact phone (last-10-digit normalized), email, firm_name+city, website. Compute and display the summary tiles: Total Records, New Records, Possible Duplicates, Invalid Records. Let the user review flagged duplicates and choose per-batch whether to skip duplicates or import anyway (checkbox/toggle), mirroring the leads duplicate UX.

Step 6 Assignment: provide three modes — assign all to a specific B2B user (profile select), assign to the B2B team (leave unassigned / assigned_to null for pool pickup), or round-robin across selected B2B users (deterministic cycling in a pure helper). Put the round-robin + validation + dedupe logic in src/lib/b2b-import.ts as PURE functions and cover them in src/lib/b2b-import.test.ts (round-robin distribution, phone-normalized dedupe, firm_name+city dedupe, invalid detection).

Step 7 Import: in one flow, (a) insert a b2b_import_batches row capturing source, file name, uploaded_by, and the counts (total/new/duplicate/invalid/assigned); (b) create/dedupe ca_firms (one firm per unique firm identity) and attach contacts; (c) insert b2b_leads rows stamped with import_batch_id and the chosen assigned_to. Chunk inserts (~200) like leads/import.tsx. Show a completion summary with counts and a link to the batch.

Create route src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/import/history.tsx (or b2b/import-history.tsx) — Import History list (spec section 8): Import ID, Date, Uploaded By, Source, File Name, Total, New, Duplicate, Invalid, Assigned. Clicking a batch opens the records for that import_batch_id (filter the B2B Leads list by batch, or a detail view).

Add 'Import Leads' under the Prospecting nav group and 'Import History' reachable from it. guardRoles(['admin','b2b']) on both routes. RLS already allows b2b users to insert their own batches/leads; admin sees all.
Rebuild to regenerate routeTree.gen.ts and commit. Prettier new files.
acceptance_criteria: The import page supports the full 7-step flow: upload, preview, column mapping, validation, duplicate detection with Total/New/Duplicate/Invalid counts and review, assignment (specific user / team / round-robin), and import.
Imported rows create/dedupe CA Firms + contacts and B2B leads, all stamped with the batch's import_batch_id.
A b2b_import_batches row is written per import with correct counts; Import History lists batches and drills into their records.
Pure validate/dedupe/round-robin logic lives in src/lib/b2b-import.ts and is covered by b2b-import.test.ts (all tests pass).
`npx tsc --noEmit` clean, `bun run test` green, `bun run build` succeeds.
verification: Confirm b2b-import.test.ts exercises round-robin distribution and the four dedupe key combinations and would fail if the logic were reverted.
findings: Gate green: npx tsc --noEmit clean; bun run test = 179 passed / 13 files (153 after FEAT-003 + 26 new b2b-import tests); bun run build ok (~12s) and regenerated src/routeTree.gen.ts with both new routes. Delivered: (1) src/lib/b2b-import.ts — PURE, DB-free logic: normalizePhone (last-10-digit, <10 digits => '' so blanks never collide), normalizeEmail, normalizeWebsite (strips scheme/www/path), firmCityKey; validateRow (requires firm_name + one usable phone/email, flags Malformed Phone/Email); the four dedupe keys (phone[], email, firm_name+city, website) via rowDedupeKeys/recordDedupeKeys/buildDedupeIndex/matchedKeys; classifyRows (invalid first, then duplicate vs new, checking BOTH existing records AND earlier rows in the same file — first occurrence counts as new); roundRobinAssign (deterministic i%n cycling) + resolveAssignments (specific/team/round_robin) + countAssigned. (2) src/lib/b2b-import.test.ts — 26 tests that genuinely exercise all four dedupe key combos (separate it() each matching phone/email/firm_name+city/website), round-robin distribution (exact ['a','b','c','a',...] sequence + even {u1:4,u2:3,u3:3} split), within-file dedupe, and invalid detection; they would fail if the logic were reverted. (3) src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/import.tsx — full 7-step flow (upload -> map -> review -> assign -> done) with a StepIndicator; reuses the proven parseCSV/normalizeHeader/synonym auto-map/header-row-detection from leads/import.tsx adapted to the 14 B2B fields; Total/New/Possible-Duplicate/Invalid tiles; skip-duplicates toggle; 3 assignment modes; on Import it (a) writes a b2b_import_batches row with all counts, (b) create/dedupes ca_firms by firm_name+city within the batch and attaches a primary contact, (c) inserts b2b_leads stamped with import_batch_id + chosen assigned_to; inserts chunked at 200; logAudit('b2b_lead','create'). (4) src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/import-history.tsx — Import History table (Import ID, Date, Uploaded By, Source, File Name, Total/New/Duplicate/Invalid/Assigned); clicking a row drills into that batch's records via listB2BLeads({importBatchId}). (5) src/lib/b2b-queries.ts extended (additive): getImportBatch, createImportBatch, listFirmDedupeRows, listLeadDedupeRows, bulkInsertFirms/Contacts/Leads, DedupeRow/NewImportBatch/NewB2BLeadRow types, and B2BLeadFilters.importBatchId. (6) app-shell.tsx: added 'Import Leads' (/b2b/import) + 'Import History' (/b2b/import-history) flat NAV items gated ['admin','b2b']. GOTCHAS: (a) IMPORTANT routing gotcha — a nested src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/import/history.tsx makes import.tsx a LAYOUT parent of history (routeTree shows AuthenticatedB2bImportRouteWithChildren) and would require an <Outlet/> in import.tsx for /b2b/import/history to render its child; I used the flat sibling path src/routes/_authenticated/b2b/import-history.tsx instead (spec allowed either) so both are independent leaf routes. Later phases adding b2b/<x>.tsx + b2b/<x>/<y>.tsx must either add an Outlet or use a flat name. (b) b2b_leads has NO firm_name column (firm_name lives on ca_firms) so listLeadDedupeRows only contributes phone/alt_phone/email/website/city keys; firm_name+city dedupe comes from ca_firms only — this is correct per the model. (c) app-shell carries 13 pre-existing prettier errors; adding 'Upload, History' to the already-flagged long import line (not a new short line) kept it at exactly 13 — do NOT run prettier --write on app-shell.tsx. (d) new .tsx/.ts files are prettier-clean (ran prettier --write; eslint 0 problems on all new files). (e) TanStack Router has no validateSearch anywhere in the repo, so batch drill-down is in-page local state (click a batch row) rather than a ?batch= search param — avoids typed-search friction. (f) typed navigate({to:...}) and <Link to=...> only accept known paths, so new routes must be built once (routeTree regenerated) before cross-links typecheck; the first tsc run errored on the new paths until bun run build regenerated the tree.
